label: scope5-negative-control
description: Authored negative control: the policy must NOT wave through a genuine plan_correctness defect just because refinement has passed the round threshold. Rounds 1-3 each surface and fix a distinct plan_correctness finding (C1, C2, C3), carrying the negotiation past the default threshold (3). Round 4 surfaces a genuine first-occurrence plan_correctness defect (C4) — an impossible/contradictory instruction, not a verification-hardening ask. Because a round-forcing plan_correctness blocker is open past the threshold, the round is NOT eligible for the accept-with-debt landing: the disposition stays request_revision (four forced rounds), the run does not accept, and nothing is converted to debt (finalPlanReviewDebt is empty). Contrast the all-hardening-tail fixture, whose post-threshold tail carries only verification_hardening findings and lands accepted-with-debt.

reviewerFindings.claimDigest: The plan omits an execution-queue section required by its declared shape.
A scope success condition contradicts its verification command.
The plan directs an edit to a consumer it explicitly places out of scope.
The plan instructs adding a second string model to a call site whose args already require a LanguageModel; the field change is impossible.
